units.source_text: 皇太子年方六岁，长得非常美丽。

en.t: The Crown Prince was just six years old, and he had grown very beautiful.

units.source_text: 他许久不见母亲，见了异常兴奋，无限欢喜，偎依母亲膝下，十分亲昵。

en.t: He had not seen his mother for a long time, and when he saw her he was extraordinarily excited and endlessly happy, nestling at her knees with great affection.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后看了心生怜爱，出家之念顿时动摇。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo saw this, pity and love welled up in her heart, and her resolve to take religious vows at once began to waver.

units.source_text: 然而环顾宫中模样，已完全改变，显然是右大臣家的天下了。

en.t: Yet when she looked around at the state of the palace, everything had changed completely; it was plainly now the realm of the Minister of the Right's family.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后性情非常刻毒，藤壶皇后出入宫禁，颇感乏味，凡事动辄得咎。

en.t: The Empress Dowager of Kokiden was extremely malicious by nature, and Empress Fujitsubo found coming and going within the palace oppressive, for she was blamed at every turn.

units.source_text: 她觉得长此下去，对皇太子甚是不利。

en.t: She felt that if things continued this way, it would be very disadvantageous for the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 想起种种事情，都有不吉之感。

en.t: When she thought back over all kinds of matters, each one gave her an ominous feeling.

units.source_text: 便问皇太子道：“今后我再隔长久不和你见面，

en.t: So she asked the Crown Prince, "If from now on I again go a long time without seeing you,

units.source_text: 见时我的样子倘使变得难看了，你会怎么样呢？”

en.t: and when we meet my appearance has become ugly, what would you do?"

units.source_text: 皇太子注视母亲的脸，笑着答道：“变得同式部一样么？

en.t: The Crown Prince gazed at his mother's face and answered with a smile, "Would you become like Shikibu?

units.source_text: 怎么会呢！”

en.t: How could that ever happen!"

units.source_text: 他的样子十分可爱。

en.t: His manner was extremely adorable.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后哭着说：“式部是因为年纪老了，所以难看。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo said through her tears, "Shikibu is ugly because she has grown old.

units.source_text: 我不是同她一样。

en.t: I will not be the same as her.

units.source_text: 我要把头发剪得比式部更短，穿上黑色的衣服，

en.t: I am going to cut my hair even shorter than Shikibu's and put on black robes,

units.source_text: 像守夜僧一样。

en.t: like a monk who keeps the night watch.

units.source_text: 这以后，和你见面的时候更少了。”

en.t: After that, the times when I can see you will be even fewer."

units.source_text: 皇太子认真地说：“像以前那样长久不见，我已舍不得，怎么可以更少呢？”

en.t: The Crown Prince said earnestly, "Even being unable to see you for so long as before is already unbearable to me; how could it become even less?"

units.source_text: 说着，流下泪来，也知道怕难为情，把头转向一旁了。

en.t: As he spoke, tears began to fall, and, knowing that he felt embarrassed, he turned his head aside.

units.source_text: 那头发摇摇晃晃的，非常可爱。

en.t: His hair swayed back and forth, and it was very charming.

units.source_text: 他渐渐长大起来，声音笑貌越发肖似源氏，竟像是一个模子里印出来的。

en.t: As he gradually grew older, his voice, smile, and features came to resemble Genji more and more, as if they had been stamped from the same mold.

units.source_text: 他的牙齿略有些蛀，口中有一点黑，笑的时候异常美观，同女孩一般秀丽。

en.t: His teeth were a little decayed, and there was a slight darkness in his mouth, but when he smiled he was extraordinarily beautiful, as graceful as a girl.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后看见他如此肖似源氏，甚是伤心，觉得这正是白璧之瑕。

en.t: Seeing him resemble Genji so closely, Empress Fujitsubo was deeply saddened and felt that this was the flaw in a flawless jade.

units.source_text: 她生怕世人看出隐情，流传恶名。

en.t: She was terribly afraid that people would see through the hidden truth and spread a shameful rumor.
